description: This file defines a data model for ARQ configuration using Pydantic, including a class ARQConfig with fields specifying window size and max retransmissions.

classes.name: ARQConfig
classes.description: Configuration model for ARQ window size and retransmission settings.

methods.name: ARQConfig
methods.description: Constructor for the ARQConfig class, initializes default values for window_size and max_retx.

ctags.name: max_retx
ctags.pattern: /^    max_retx: int = Field(3, ge=0, le=16, description="Max retransmissions per packet.")$/

ctags.name: window_size
ctags.pattern: /^    window_size: int = Field(16, ge=1, le=1024, description="Sliding window size.")$/
